is_sales_lead.description: True only if the caller is a prospective buyer. False for wrong numbers, support requests, spam, job seekers and vendors.

first_name.description: Only if stated by the caller.

last_name.description: Only if stated by the caller.

email.description: Only if stated by the caller.

phone.description: Only if stated by the caller.

company.description: Only if stated by the caller.

job_title.description: Only if stated by the caller.

need_summary.description: What the caller needs, in one or two sentences.

mentioned.description: True if the caller mentioned any budget or spend figure.

amount_usd.description: Budget amount in US dollars (converted with the rate table in the system prompt if the caller used another currency), or null.

buying_intent_score.description: 1-10 per the scoring rubric in the system prompt.

intent_evidence.description: Paraphrase of what the caller said that justifies the score.

follow_up_required.description: True if a human should follow up with the caller.

call_summary.description: Neutral summary of the call for the Salesforce Task.
